title: ASELSAN Is Developing a Hypersonic-Tracking Radar for SİPER's Upper Layer
excerpt: ASELSAN is developing a Multi-Function Fire Control Radar based on X- and L-band fusion for systems to be positioned above SİPER, while ROKETSAN continues scramjet and terminal-maneuver work.
